planning.title: Project planning
planning.intro: Create and review WBS drafts. Planning never creates work items, assigns members or changes deadlines.
planning.name: Plan title
planning.lines: Enter one item per line. Leave unknown information blank.
planning.noAccess: You cannot read planning drafts in this project.
planning.leave: Leave this draft? Unsaved changes will be lost.
planning.sourceHelp: References identify ordered extracted text blocks, not PDF page numbers. Verify evidence against the original document.
planning.limits: Up to 3 PDF/DOCX files, 5 MB each; text-based PDFs only. Sources are shared with project readers. Extraction is limited to 60,000 characters per file and 80,000 combined.
planning.fileTooLarge: Choose a file smaller than 5 MB.
planning.readFailed: Could not read the selected file.
planning.readOnly: You can read this draft. Editing requires project document edit permission.
planning.taskHelp: One level of subtasks. Copy task IDs to set dependencies. Unknown estimates stay blank. Use brief or exact source block references for evidence.
planning.generateHelp: Save your changes first. Generation sends this draft and its source text to the selected agent’s provider and may incur provider charges. The result is a preview; review it before applying and saving.
planning.noProvider: No available internal agent. Manual drafting remains available. Configure a model credential and an internal agent for this project to generate with AI.
planning.preview: AI preview — verify assumptions and source evidence. Your saved draft is unchanged.
planning.relevanceHelp: The brief defines scope. Review how each document was classified and which extracted blocks influenced the WBS.
planning.relevanceNone: No source documents were assessed. The WBS is based on the project brief.
planning.replace: Replace your unsaved edits with this AI preview?
